editorial:
Imagine being trapped in your own home with a sibling who absolutely despises you. That is the nightmare you get with this story. You follow two sisters who used to be famous, but now they live in a huge, decaying house. One sister is stuck in a wheelchair and can't move, while the other sister acts as her nurse. The problem is that the nurse is actually a cruel bully who uses her power to torture her sister. It feels like a creepy game of cat and mouse where the stakes are life and death, and the tension builds up every time someone walks through the door.

The acting is the best part here because the lead actress goes all out to be truly scary. You will find yourself rooting for the bedridden sister to escape. While the movie is a bit slow at the start, the twists keep you interested. If you love old-school thrillers with a dark family secret, you will love this. Since it is an older TV movie, you might want to look for a high-quality digital version. You can try renting it on Apple TV or adding the Blu-ray to your physical collection if you want the best picture quality for your home theater.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out that the sister in the wheelchair was not actually paralyzed the whole time. She was pretending so she could figure out a way to survive and trick her mean sister. After a final big fight, the truth comes out about who really caused the accident years ago. The bully sister finally loses her mind and the cycle of hate ends in a tragic way, leaving the house silent at last.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and family dramas.
